# Trident Music — Full Details

> DJ and event entertainment company serving Manitoba and Saskatchewan, Canada.

## Company Overview

Trident Music is the entertainment division of Trident Event Group, the premier DJ and event entertainment service in Manitoba and Saskatchewan. Founded in Brandon, Manitoba, the company has grown from a single DJ with a laptop and one speaker to a 16-person team that handles hundreds of events annually across the Canadian prairies.

What sets Trident Music apart is our approach: every event gets a personalized music consultation, our DJs read the room and adjust in real time (no pre-set playlists on autopilot), and we bring professional-grade equipment with full backup systems to every gig. Our reputation is built on one consistent outcome — packed dance floors from the first song to the last.

## Services

### Wedding Entertainment
Full-service wedding DJ and MC packages including ceremony music, cocktail hour, dinner music, grand entrance coordination, first dance, parent dances, and open dance floor. Includes pre-wedding music consultation, professional sound system, intelligent lighting, and wireless microphones for speeches. We've worked with every major wedding venue in Brandon, Winnipeg, and Regina.

### Social Entertainment
DJ services for socials, fundraisers, holiday parties, birthday celebrations, and community events. Our DJs know how to work every type of crowd — from formal sit-down affairs to high-energy dance parties.

### Corporate Events & Galas
Professional entertainment for corporate galas, awards nights, holiday parties, product launches, and company celebrations. We handle events from 50 to 300+ guests with appropriate sound, lighting, and MC services.

### Schools & Graduation Parties
Graduation ceremonies, grad parties, school dances, and prom events. We've been the go-to DJ for schools across Manitoba for years — students literally count down to the dance because they know it's going to go off.

### PhotoBooth
Photo booth rental services for weddings, corporate events, and parties. Fun props, instant prints, and digital sharing.

### A/V Equipment Rental
Professional audio and visual equipment rental for events that need sound systems, lighting, or AV support without full DJ services.

## Locations and Service Area

### Brandon Headquarters
- **Address:** 381 Park Avenue East, Brandon, MB R7A 7A5
- **Region:** Brandon and the Westman area
- **Notable venues served:** Victoria Inn, Keystone Centre, Royal Oak Inn, Assiniboine Community College

### Winnipeg Office
- **Address:** 425 Ballantrae Dr, Winnipeg, MB R3T 6H6
- **Region:** Winnipeg and surrounding areas
- **Notable venues served:** The Metropolitan Entertainment Centre, The Fort Garry Hotel, The Gates on Roblin, Club Fenom, The Norwood Hotel, Hazelton Estate, Assiniboine Park Pavilion, Manitoba Club, Delta Hotels Winnipeg

### Regina / Saskatchewan Coverage
- **Served from:** Brandon headquarters
- **Region:** Regina, Saskatchewan, and surrounding areas
- **Notable venues served:** Hotel Saskatchewan, Atlas Hotel, Wascana Country Club, Conexus Arts Centre
- Travel included in all Saskatchewan quotes

### Full Service Area
Brandon, Winnipeg, Steinbach, Portage la Prairie, Dauphin, Thompson, Selkirk, Regina, Moose Jaw, Saskatoon, and all surrounding communities across Manitoba and Saskatchewan. We travel to rural communities and destination events throughout Western Canada.

## What's Included in Every Booking

- Dedicated DJ/MC for the full event
- Pre-event music consultation to learn your taste and timeline
- Professional sound system sized for your venue
- Intelligent lighting that sets the mood
- Wireless microphones for speeches and toasts
- Setup and teardown included
- Travel included — no hidden fees
- Full backup equipment on-site

## Pricing and Booking

Trident Music provides custom quotes based on event type, date, duration, and location. To get a quote or check date availability, visit https://tridentmusic.ca/inquire. Response time is within 24 hours.
